pkgmetadata.longdescription: Reference storage plugin of the Horcrux manager: keeps VM volumes (qcow2 with internal snapshots, or raw) in a directory on an SSH server, mounted with SSHFS. Once installed, "SSHFS (plugin)" is a storage type in Storage > Create Pool, with a form generated from the plugin's schema. The plugin runs only when the manager calls it (no service on OpenRC or systemd). See docs/storage-plugins.md in the Horcrux repository.
